title: Equipment Datasheet - POLYMER FLUID BED DRYER (YD-2301)
content:
EQUIPMENT DATASHEET: YD-2301 (POLYMER FLUID BED DRYER).
Document No: TJC-LLD-DS-YD-2301, Revision: Rev 3, Status: Issued for Operation.
Equipment Type: Rotary Steam-Tube Dryer.
Plant Unit: Linear Low Density Polyethylene (LLDPE) Unit, Area: 2300 – Polymer Separation & Drying.
Functional Location: TJC-LLD-2300-01, Criticality: High Critical.
Service: Drying of LLDPE polymer powder from centrifuge to < 300 ppm moisture.
MECHANICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
Dryer Type: ROTARY STEAM-TUBE, INDIRECT; Drum Diameter: 1800 mm; Drum Length: 9000 mm; Rotation Speed: 4 rpm; Heating Medium: LP STEAM 4.5 barg; Inert Medium: NITROGEN; Design Temp.: 150 degC; Operating Temp.: 95-110 degC; Body Material: SM400B; Rotor Shaft: SM400B / SS400; Gland Packing: PTFE (PILLER 4526L); Oil Seal: NBR; O-Ring: NBR; Rotary Joint: ASSEMBLY, KADANT; Drive: CHAIN & SPROCKET SCM440
MOTOR & ELECTRICAL SPECIFICATIONS:
Output: 22 kW; Poles: 4 POLE; Speed: 1450 rpm; Voltage: 380 V / 3 Ph / 50 Hz; Rated Current: 43 A; Insulation Class: F; Enclosure: TEFC IP55; Area Classification: ZONE 2, IIA T3; Ex Protection: Ex nA IIC T3 Gc; Frame: IEC 180L; Weight (Motor+Gearbox): 833 kg; Driver Type: Electric Motor via Chain-Sprocket, TEFC
CROSS REFERENCES: P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-2301, Interlock: SEQ-5500.
